v0.9.0: make the public default normalizer checkpoint-safe

upgrade: Direct callers and wrappers that used `default_normalizer(record, descriptor)` must switch to `make_normalizer(cursor_column=..., pk_columns=...)`: the default now raises `ConfigurationError` when the descriptor has no cursor metadata, and `PollRunner` rejects the unconfigured default at construction. `PollTrigger` resolves the default from the source's cursor/key metadata, and omitted or custom normalizers keep their behavior (#503).
Reminder: this package provides a poll-based pseudo trigger built on the Azure Functions timer trigger. It is not a native Azure Functions SQL trigger or binding extension.
